description:
Update your podcast generation preferences. Requires authentication. All fields are optional.

**Settings:**
- language: Language code (max 5 chars). Supported: "en" (English), "es" (Spanish), "fr" (French), "de" (German), "it" (Italian), "pt" (Portuguese)
- accent: Voice accent. Options: "US" (American), "UK" (British), "AU" (Australian)
- num_tutors: 1 (Solo narrator) or 2 (Duo conversation)
- podcast_length_min/max: Target length in minutes (1-10)
- speaking_styles: Array like ["Conversational"], ["Educational", "Enthusiastic"], etc.

**Examples:**
- Spanish podcast: {"language": "es"}
- British English: {"language": "en", "accent": "UK"}
- Formal duo: {"num_tutors": 2, "speaking_styles": ["Formal", "Educational"]}

FREE (no coin cost).
name: change_podcast_settings
title: Change Podcast Settings
